source_text: 1Hero!?

structure.raw_value: JoWoOp.1Hero!?
structure.script_literal: "JoWoOp.1Hero!?"

translation: 1Hero!?

source_text: What are you doing? You startled me…

structure.raw_value: JoWoCl.What are you doing? You startled me…
structure.script_literal: "JoWoCl.What are you doing? You startled me…"

translation: Co tu robisz? Przestraszyłeś mnie…

source_text: This is my secure storage location… But you have to leave; I’m expecting some company.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.This is my secure storage location… But you have to leave; I’m expecting some company.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.This is my secure storage location… But you have to leave; I’m expecting some company."

translation: To mój bezpieczny schowek… Ale musisz już iść. Ktoś ma mnie odwiedzić.

source_text: Jon… The police are on their way.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Jon… The police are on their way.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Jon… The police are on their way."

translation: Jon… Policja już jedzie.

source_text: Sorry, Jon. But if you’re not careful, in the next few minutes you could end up dead.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Sorry, Jon. But if you’re not careful, in the next few minutes you could end up dead.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Sorry, Jon. But if you’re not careful, in the next few minutes you could end up dead."

translation: Przykro mi, Jon. Ale jeśli nie będziesz ostrożny, za kilka minut możesz nie żyć.

source_text: Hey! What the hell is he doing here?

structure.raw_value: H2MaOp^.Hey! What the hell is he doing here?
structure.script_literal: "H2MaOp^.Hey! What the hell is he doing here?"

translation: Hej! Co on tu, do cholery, robi?

source_text: Looks like the jig is up! The cops are onto us!

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe^.Looks like the jig is up! The cops are onto us!
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe^.Looks like the jig is up! The cops are onto us!"

translation: Wygląda na to, że po nas! Gliniarze się połapali!

source_text: Shit! Where is Melissa?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Shit! Where is Melissa?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Shit! Where is Melissa?"

translation: Cholera! Gdzie jest Melissa?

source_text: Freeze! You’re all under arrest!

structure.raw_value: MeMaAg.Freeze! You’re all under arrest!
structure.script_literal: "MeMaAg.Freeze! You’re all under arrest!"

translation: Stać! Wszyscy jesteście aresztowani!

source_text: Shit! I don’t have my gun!

structure.raw_value: H2ShCl>.Shit! I don’t have my gun!
structure.script_literal: "H2ShCl>.Shit! I don’t have my gun!"

translation: Cholera! Nie mam broni!

source_text: Neither do I!

structure.raw_value: HwWoCl>.Neither do I!
structure.script_literal: "HwWoCl>.Neither do I!"

translation: Ja też nie!

source_text: Drop the weapon!

structure.raw_value: BoMaAgNo1.Drop the weapon!
structure.script_literal: "BoMaAgNo1.Drop the weapon!"

translation: Rzuć broń!

source_text: Don’t do this, Nellie.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl<.Don’t do this, Nellie.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl<.Don’t do this, Nellie."

translation: Nie rób tego, Nellie.

source_text: Get back, or I’ll kill him!

structure.raw_value: H2MaAg>.Get back, or I’ll kill him!
structure.script_literal: "H2MaAg>.Get back, or I’ll kill him!"

translation: Cofnijcie się albo go zabiję!

source_text: Get off of me, you freak!

structure.raw_value: JoMaAgNo1.Get off of me, you freak!
structure.script_literal: "JoMaAgNo1.Get off of me, you freak!"

translation: Puść mnie, ty zwyrolu!

source_text: Let him go! You have no escape!

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Let him go! You have no escape!
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Let him go! You have no escape!"

translation: Puść go! Nie masz dokąd uciec!

source_text: You’ll blow your cover!

structure.raw_value: McWoEx<.You’ll blow your cover!
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx<.You’ll blow your cover!"

translation: Spalisz swoją przykrywkę!

source_text: They need to die!

structure.raw_value: NeMaAgNo1.They need to die!
structure.script_literal: "NeMaAgNo1.They need to die!"

translation: Oni muszą zginąć!

source_text: After them!

structure.raw_value: BoMaAgNo1.After them!
structure.script_literal: "BoMaAgNo1.After them!"

translation: Za nimi!

source_text: Wait! Stop!

structure.raw_value: MeMaAgNo1.Wait! Stop!
structure.script_literal: "MeMaAgNo1.Wait! Stop!"

translation: Czekaj! Stój!

source_text: Make sure no one leaves this warehouse…

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Make sure no one leaves this warehouse…
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Make sure no one leaves this warehouse…"

translation: Dopilnuj, żeby nikt nie opuścił tego magazynu…

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. We can’t let them get away.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Come on, 1Hero. We can’t let them get away.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Come on, 1Hero. We can’t let them get away."

translation: Chodź, 1Hero. Nie możemy pozwolić im uciec.

source_text: This is it? Four people?

structure.raw_value: KiWoOp.This is it? Four people?
structure.script_literal: "KiWoOp.This is it? Four people?"

translation: To już wszyscy? Tylko cztery osoby?

source_text: The leader got away.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.The leader got away.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.The leader got away."

translation: Przywódca uciekł.

source_text: Bullshit! These are the kingpins and I’m the undercover agent who took them down.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.Bullshit! These are the kingpins and I’m the undercover agent who took them down.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.Bullshit! These are the kingpins and I’m the undercover agent who took them down."

translation: Gówno prawda! To najważniejsi ludzie w tej szajce, a ja jestem tajniakiem, który ich dorwał.

source_text: You lying bitch!

structure.raw_value: H2MaAg^.You lying bitch!
structure.script_literal: "H2MaAg^.You lying bitch!"

translation: Ty kłamliwa suko!

source_text: Take them to the station.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.Take them to the station.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.Take them to the station."

translation: Zabrać ich na komisariat.

source_text: Hey! I’m not a part of their gang.

structure.raw_value: JoAnOp>.Hey! I’m not a part of their gang.
structure.script_literal: "JoAnOp>.Hey! I’m not a part of their gang."

translation: Hej! Nie należę do ich gangu.

source_text: You’re getting questioned too, Dundee.

structure.raw_value: BoAnEx.You’re getting questioned too, Dundee.
structure.script_literal: "BoAnEx.You’re getting questioned too, Dundee."

translation: Ciebie też przesłuchamy, Dundee.

source_text: You’re all going to jail for a long, long time.

structure.raw_value: OaAnDe^.You’re all going to jail for a long, long time.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnDe^.You’re all going to jail for a long, long time."

translation: Wszyscy pójdziecie siedzieć na bardzo, bardzo długo.

source_text: Get the shot!

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.Get the shot!
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.Get the shot!"

translation: Nagraj to!

source_text: I’m getting it!

structure.raw_value: PlHaOp^.I’m getting it!
structure.script_literal: "PlHaOp^.I’m getting it!"

translation: Nagrywam!

source_text: A job well done, team.

structure.raw_value: NeFlOp.A job well done, team.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlOp.A job well done, team."

translation: Dobra robota, drużyno.

source_text: It’s hard to believe that the Eclipse Guild has been here in North Santiva.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.It’s hard to believe that the Eclipse Guild has been here in North Santiva.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.It’s hard to believe that the Eclipse Guild has been here in North Santiva."

translation: Trudno uwierzyć, że Gildia Zaćmienia działała tutaj, w North Santiva.

source_text: It’s been a long case, that’s for sure. But nothing Nellie Cole couldn’t handle.

structure.raw_value: NeFlOp.It’s been a long case, that’s for sure. But nothing Nellie Cole couldn’t handle.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlOp.It’s been a long case, that’s for sure. But nothing Nellie Cole couldn’t handle."

translation: To była długa sprawa, nie ma co. Ale Nellie Cole dała sobie z nią radę.

source_text: That’s your name, Nellie Cole?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.That’s your name, Nellie Cole?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.That’s your name, Nellie Cole?"

translation: Nazywasz się Nellie Cole?

source_text: I’m the lead detective on this case. We were lucky to be here thanks to an anonymous tip.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.I’m the lead detective on this case. We were lucky to be here thanks to an anonymous tip.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.I’m the lead detective on this case. We were lucky to be here thanks to an anonymous tip."

translation: Prowadzę to śledztwo. Dzięki anonimowemu zgłoszeniu mieliśmy szczęście tu dotrzeć.

source_text: Not from me… It’s a total coincidence that the officers showed up when they did.

structure.raw_value: NeHaCl.Not from me… It’s a total coincidence that the officers showed up when they did.
structure.script_literal: "NeHaCl.Not from me… It’s a total coincidence that the officers showed up when they did."

translation: To nie ja… To zupełny przypadek, że funkcjonariusze pojawili się akurat wtedy.

source_text: 1Hero! Say something. Women over 45 love you!

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx^.1Hero! Say something. Women over 45 love you!
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx^.1Hero! Say something. Women over 45 love you!"

translation: 1Hero! Powiedz coś. Kobiety po czterdziestce cię uwielbiają!

source_text: What can I say? We took them down.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.What can I say? We took them down.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.What can I say? We took them down."

translation: Co mam powiedzieć? Dopadliśmy ich.

source_text: Is there anyone left? Any other connections that you might want to mention?

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Is there anyone left? Any other connections that you might want to mention?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Is there anyone left? Any other connections that you might want to mention?"

translation: Został jeszcze ktoś? Są jakieś inne powiązania, o których warto wspomnieć?

source_text: Charles Wilkes was their leader. Without him, they are falling apart.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx^.Charles Wilkes was their leader. Without him, they are falling apart.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx^.Charles Wilkes was their leader. Without him, they are falling apart."

translation: Ich przywódcą był Charles Wilkes. Bez niego cała organizacja się rozpada.

source_text: Oh, shit… I had no idea that Wilkes was connected to this. What a funny coincidence!

structure.raw_value: NeWoCl.Oh, shit… I had no idea that Wilkes was connected to this. What a funny coincidence!
structure.script_literal: "NeWoCl.Oh, shit… I had no idea that Wilkes was connected to this. What a funny coincidence!"

translation: O, cholera… Nie miałam pojęcia, że Wilkes był z tym powiązany. Cóż za zabawny zbieg okoliczności!

source_text: Sounds like the Guild has been operating here a long time.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Sounds like the Guild has been operating here a long time.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Sounds like the Guild has been operating here a long time."

translation: Wygląda na to, że Gildia działa tu od dawna.

source_text: Cut!

structure.raw_value: PlAnOp^.Cut!
structure.script_literal: "PlAnOp^.Cut!"

translation: Cięcie!

source_text: What the hell is wrong with you three? Give us something juicy!

structure.raw_value: PlAnEx^.What the hell is wrong with you three? Give us something juicy!
structure.script_literal: "PlAnEx^.What the hell is wrong with you three? Give us something juicy!"

translation: Co z wami, do cholery, jest nie tak? Powiedzcie coś ciekawego!

source_text: I have interrogations to attend to. I’ll spill every detail once I know more.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.I have interrogations to attend to. I’ll spill every detail once I know more.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.I have interrogations to attend to. I’ll spill every detail once I know more."

translation: Muszę przesłuchiwać podejrzanych. Zdradzę wszystkie szczegóły, gdy dowiem się czegoś więcej.

source_text: Yeah! Me too!... Nellie Cole has all the juicy details.

structure.raw_value: NeHaEx.Yeah! Me too!... Nellie Cole has all the juicy details.
structure.script_literal: "NeHaEx.Yeah! Me too!... Nellie Cole has all the juicy details."

translation: Tak! Ja też!... Nellie Cole zna wszystkie pikantne szczegóły.

source_text: Let’s get them on set…

structure.raw_value: PlBaEx^.Let’s get them on set…
structure.script_literal: "PlBaEx^.Let’s get them on set… "

translation: Zaprowadźmy ich na plan…

source_text: How long will these interrogations last?

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp^.How long will these interrogations last?
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp^.How long will these interrogations last?"

translation: Jak długo potrwają te przesłuchania?

source_text: Could be the rest of the day… into the night.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.Could be the rest of the day… into the night.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.Could be the rest of the day… into the night."

translation: Może do końca dnia… a nawet do nocy.

source_text: Looks like another late one, Paul.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Looks like another late one, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Looks like another late one, Paul."

translation: Zapowiada się kolejna długa noc, Paul.

source_text: Let me get some more b-roll and I’ll meet you back at Channel 4.

structure.raw_value: PlFrEx^.Let me get some more b-roll and I’ll meet you back at Channel 4.
structure.script_literal: "PlFrEx^.Let me get some more b-roll and I’ll meet you back at Channel 4."

translation: Nakręcę jeszcze trochę przebitek i spotkamy się w Channel 4.

source_text: This is the big one, Paul.

structure.raw_value: KiHaOp.This is the big one, Paul.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOp.This is the big one, Paul."

translation: To będzie wielki materiał, Paul.

source_text: Do you have photos of the painting? Where is it?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Do you have photos of the painting? Where is it?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Do you have photos of the painting? Where is it?"

translation: Masz zdjęcia obrazu? Gdzie on jest?

source_text: It’s… uhh… I don’t remember.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.It’s… uhh… I don’t remember.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.It’s… uhh… I don’t remember."

translation: To… eee… nie pamiętam.

source_text: You don’t remember?

structure.raw_value: KiAnDe.You don’t remember?
structure.script_literal: "KiAnDe.You don’t remember?"

translation: Nie pamiętasz?

source_text: We’ll give you everything tonight. Just be sure to run a teaser as soon as you can.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.We’ll give you everything tonight. Just be sure to run a teaser as soon as you can.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.We’ll give you everything tonight. Just be sure to run a teaser as soon as you can."

translation: Wieczorem wszystko ci opowiemy. Tylko puść zapowiedź, jak najszybciej.

source_text: In a hurry?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.In a hurry?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.In a hurry?"

translation: Spieszysz się?

source_text: We’re counting on you to get the word out as soon as possible.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.We’re counting on you to get the word out as soon as possible.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.We’re counting on you to get the word out as soon as possible."

translation: Liczymy na to, że jak najszybciej puścisz tę informację w świat.

source_text: 1Hero, I suggest you speak with the commissioner sooner rather than later.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.1Hero, I suggest you speak with the commissioner sooner rather than later.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.1Hero, I suggest you speak with the commissioner sooner rather than later."

translation: 1Hero, radzę, żebyś jak najszybciej porozmawiał z panią komisarz.

source_text: Yeah… I know.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.Yeah… I know.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.Yeah… I know."

translation: Tak… Wiem.

source_text: Can I come to the station with you?

structure.raw_value: NeHaOp.Can I come to the station with you?
structure.script_literal: "NeHaOp.Can I come to the station with you?"

translation: Mogę pojechać z tobą na komisariat?

source_text: Of course. You’ll be questioned too.

structure.raw_value: MeFlEx^.Of course. You’ll be questioned too.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlEx^.Of course. You’ll be questioned too."

translation: Oczywiście. Ciebie też przesłuchamy.

source_text: She doesn’t mean that! She’s joking!

structure.raw_value: NeHaEx!c.She doesn’t mean that! She’s joking!
structure.script_literal: "NeHaEx!c.She doesn’t mean that! She’s joking!"

translation: Ona nie mówi poważnie! Żartuje!

source_text: A heroic team. Good job.

structure.raw_value: KiHaOp.A heroic team. Good job.
structure.script_literal: "KiHaOp.A heroic team. Good job."

translation: Bohaterska drużyna. Dobra robota.

source_text: Happy to serve the community of North Salvania!

structure.raw_value: NeHaEx.Happy to serve the community of North Salvania!
structure.script_literal: "NeHaEx.Happy to serve the community of North Salvania!"

translation: Z przyjemnością służymy mieszkańcom North Salvania!

source_text: Santiva!

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Santiva!
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Santiva!"

translation: Santiva!

source_text: Yeah! Santiva!

structure.raw_value: NeHaEx.Yeah! Santiva!
structure.script_literal: "NeHaEx.Yeah! Santiva!"

translation: Tak! Santiva!

source_text: Will the commissioner let you get behind the camera again?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.Will the commissioner let you get behind the camera again?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.Will the commissioner let you get behind the camera again?"

translation: Czy pani komisarz pozwoli ci jeszcze stanąć za kamerą?

source_text: I don’t know. She won't be happy.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I don’t know. She won't be happy.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I don’t know. She won't be happy."

translation: Nie wiem. Nie będzie zadowolona.

source_text: You let one get away?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.You let one get away?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.You let one get away?"

translation: Jeden ci uciekł?

source_text: In her eyes, we let all of them get away.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.In her eyes, we let all of them get away.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.In her eyes, we let all of them get away."

translation: W jej oczach pozwoliliśmy uciec im wszystkim.

source_text: Good luck, 1Hero. If you don’t get your job back, you know where you’re welcome.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.Good luck, 1Hero. If you don’t get your job back, you know where you’re welcome.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.Good luck, 1Hero. If you don’t get your job back, you know where you’re welcome."

translation: Powodzenia, 1Hero. Jeśli nie odzyskasz pracy, wiesz, gdzie cię przyjmą z otwartymi ramionami.

source_text: Go on, Canmore. You can’t hang around here.

structure.raw_value: OaAnEx.Go on, Canmore. You can’t hang around here.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnEx.Go on, Canmore. You can’t hang around here."

translation: Idź już, Canmore. Nie możesz tu dłużej kręcić się bez celu.

source_text: Dig deep, officer. Don’t let Duncan get away.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Dig deep, officer. Don’t let Duncan get away.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Dig deep, officer. Don’t let Duncan get away."

translation: Daj z siebie wszystko, funkcjonariuszu. Nie pozwól Duncanowi uciec.

source_text: We know what we’re doing.

structure.raw_value: OaAnDe.We know what we’re doing.
structure.script_literal: "OaAnDe.We know what we’re doing."

translation: Wiemy, co robimy.

source_text: I got my job back.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I got my job back.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I got my job back."

translation: Odzyskałem pracę.

source_text: Packing up shop soon. Need to take tomorrow off for my court appearance.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Packing up shop soon. Need to take tomorrow off for my court appearance.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Packing up shop soon. Need to take tomorrow off for my court appearance."

translation: Niedługo zamykam interes. Jutro muszę wziąć wolne, bo mam rozprawę.

source_text: Any idea what’s going to happen?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Any idea what’s going to happen?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Any idea what’s going to happen?"

translation: Wiesz, co się wydarzy?

source_text: I was hoping you would know.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.I was hoping you would know.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.I was hoping you would know."

translation: Miałem nadzieję, że ty będziesz wiedział.

source_text: Been busy. Haven’t had a chance to talk to Commissioner Kimura… But she wants the Guild case dead… You might get lucky.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Been busy. Haven’t had a chance to talk to Commissioner Kimura… But she wants the Guild case dead… You might get lucky.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Been busy. Haven’t had a chance to talk to Commissioner Kimura… But she wants the Guild case dead… You might get lucky."

translation: Byłem zajęty. Nie miałem okazji porozmawiać z komisarz Kimurą… Ale chce, żeby sprawa Gildii umarła… Może dopisze ci szczęście.

source_text: Well… The cops left the bunker and didn’t tape it off… I guess the crime scene investigation is over.

structure.raw_value: JoFrEx.Well… The cops left the bunker and didn’t tape it off… I guess the crime scene investigation is over.
structure.script_literal: "JoFrEx.Well… The cops left the bunker and didn’t tape it off… I guess the crime scene investigation is over."

translation: Cóż… Gliniarze opuścili bunkier i go nie zabezpieczyli… Chyba zakończyli oględziny miejsca zbrodni.

source_text: Don’t be surprised if we never speak of this case again.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Don’t be surprised if we never speak of this case again.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Don’t be surprised if we never speak of this case again."

translation: Nie zdziw się, jeśli już nigdy nie wspomnimy o tej sprawie.

source_text: Come on, Jon… It’s a stain on Kimura’s reputation.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Come on, Jon… It’s a stain on Kimura’s reputation.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Come on, Jon… It’s a stain on Kimura’s reputation."

translation: Daj spokój, Jon… To plama na reputacji Kimury.

source_text: Never thought about it that way.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Never thought about it that way.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.Never thought about it that way."

translation: Nie pomyślałem o tym w ten sposób.

source_text: I don’t usually have company.

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.I don’t usually have company.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.I don’t usually have company. "

translation: Zwykle nie przyjmuję gości.

source_text: Keep an eye on Hannah.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Keep an eye on Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Keep an eye on Hannah."

translation: Miej oko na Hannah.

source_text: Hannah?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Hannah?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.Hannah?"

translation: Na Hannah?

source_text: The redhead can get wild.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.The redhead can get wild.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.The redhead can get wild."

translation: Rudowłosa potrafi zaszaleć.

source_text: This will work perfectly and just in time.

structure.raw_value: JoHaEx.This will work perfectly and just in time.
structure.script_literal: "JoHaEx.This will work perfectly and just in time."

translation: To będzie idealne rozwiązanie i w samą porę.

source_text: What are your plans for tomorrow, Jon? You’re going to court, right?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What are your plans for tomorrow, Jon? You’re going to court, right?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What are your plans for tomorrow, Jon? You’re going to court, right?"

translation: Jakie masz plany na jutro, Jon? Idziesz do sądu, prawda?

source_text: Play with fire long enough and I guess you’ll get burnt…

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Play with fire long enough and I guess you’ll get burnt…
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.Play with fire long enough and I guess you’ll get burnt…"

translation: Kto igra z ogniem, ten w końcu się poparzy…

source_text: But I might just have a way out.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.But I might just have a way out.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.But I might just have a way out."

translation: Ale chyba mam sposób, żeby się z tego wykręcić.

source_text: Jon, I need some equipment.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Jon, I need some equipment.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Jon, I need some equipment."

translation: Jon, potrzebuję sprzętu.

source_text: You wouldn’t happen to have a crossbow, would you?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You wouldn’t happen to have a crossbow, would you?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You wouldn’t happen to have a crossbow, would you?"

translation: Nie masz przypadkiem kuszy?

source_text: Why a crossbow? Don’t you have a real gun?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Why a crossbow? Don’t you have a real gun?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.Why a crossbow? Don’t you have a real gun?"

translation: Po co ci kusza? Nie masz prawdziwej broni?

source_text: I can get you a crossbow. Is that all?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.I can get you a crossbow. Is that all?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.I can get you a crossbow. Is that all?"

translation: Mogę załatwić ci kuszę. To wszystko?

source_text: I also need enough TNT to blow up a small building.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I also need enough TNT to blow up a small building.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I also need enough TNT to blow up a small building."

translation: Potrzebuję też tyle trotylu, żeby wysadzić mały budynek.

source_text: Can you get me that?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Can you get me that?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Can you get me that?"

translation: Możesz mi to załatwić?

source_text: Now that’s not going to be easy.

structure.raw_value: JoWoDe.Now that’s not going to be easy.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoDe.Now that’s not going to be easy."

translation: To nie będzie łatwe.

source_text: I’m not saying it’s impossible.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.I’m not saying it’s impossible.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.I’m not saying it’s impossible."

translation: Nie mówię, że to niemożliwe.

source_text: I also need a way to detonate it.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I also need a way to detonate it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I also need a way to detonate it."

translation: Potrzebuję też sposobu, żeby to zdetonować.

source_text: What you need is a burner cell phone.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.What you need is a burner cell phone.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.What you need is a burner cell phone."

translation: Potrzebujesz jednorazowego telefonu komórkowego.

source_text: That’s not going to work… The bomb won't have reception where we’ll be putting it.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.That’s not going to work… The bomb won't have reception where we’ll be putting it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.That’s not going to work… The bomb won't have reception where we’ll be putting it."

translation: To nie zadziała… Tam, gdzie podłożymy bombę, nie będzie zasięgu.

source_text: Then you need a countdown timer.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Then you need a countdown timer.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Then you need a countdown timer."

translation: W takim razie potrzebujesz minutnika.

source_text: Can you put that together?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Can you put that together?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Can you put that together?"

translation: Złożysz coś takiego?

source_text: I have a client that deals in road construction who has explosives… But I can’t just give you that much dynamite.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.I have a client that deals in road construction who has explosives… But I can’t just give you that much dynamite.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.I have a client that deals in road construction who has explosives… But I can’t just give you that much dynamite."

translation: Mam klienta z branży budowy dróg, który ma materiały wybuchowe… Ale nie mogę tak po prostu dać ci aż tyle dynamitu.

source_text: No chance of accidentally losing his shipment?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.No chance of accidentally losing his shipment?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.No chance of accidentally losing his shipment?"

translation: Nie ma szans, żeby jego dostawa przypadkiem się zgubiła?

source_text: You really need this, don’t you?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.You really need this, don’t you?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.You really need this, don’t you?"

translation: Naprawdę tego potrzebujesz, co?

source_text: The world depends on it.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.The world depends on it.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.The world depends on it."

translation: Los świata od tego zależy.

source_text: Let’s make a deal. Put together the detonator, I’ll make the bomb and a crossbow…

structure.raw_value: JoBaOp.Let’s make a deal. Put together the detonator, I’ll make the bomb and a crossbow…
structure.script_literal: "JoBaOp.Let’s make a deal. Put together the detonator, I’ll make the bomb and a crossbow…"

translation: Zróbmy tak: ty złożysz detonator, a ja przygotuję bombę i kuszę…

source_text: In return, I need you to find me three handguns.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.In return, I need you to find me three handguns.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.In return, I need you to find me three handguns."

translation: W zamian musisz znaleźć dla mnie trzy pistolety.

source_text: I can easily do that.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.I can easily do that.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.I can easily do that."

translation: Nie ma sprawy.

source_text: Not so fast. These handguns were tossed into the lake.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Not so fast. These handguns were tossed into the lake.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Not so fast. These handguns were tossed into the lake."

translation: Nie tak szybko. Te pistolety wrzucono do jeziora.

source_text: You can dive, can’t you?

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.You can dive, can’t you?
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.You can dive, can’t you?"

translation: Potrafisz nurkować, prawda?

source_text: Well… I can.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Well… I can.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Well… I can."

translation: Cóż… Potrafię.

source_text: Find me the handguns and the bomb is yours.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.Find me the handguns and the bomb is yours.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.Find me the handguns and the bomb is yours."

translation: Znajdź pistolety, a bomba będzie twoja.

source_text: Do I dare ask why you need these guns?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Do I dare ask why you need these guns?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Do I dare ask why you need these guns?"

translation: Czy mam odwagę zapytać, po co ci te pistolety?

source_text: Don’t ask.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.Don’t ask.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.Don’t ask."

translation: Lepiej nie pytaj.

source_text: We’re running short on time, but I’ll see what I can do.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.We’re running short on time, but I’ll see what I can do.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.We’re running short on time, but I’ll see what I can do."

translation: Kończy nam się czas, ale zobaczę, co da się zrobić.

source_text: Here’s how you make the detonator…

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Here’s how you make the detonator…
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Here’s how you make the detonator…"

translation: Tak zrobisz detonator…

source_text: You found the handguns!

structure.raw_value: JoHaOp.You found the handguns!
structure.script_literal: "JoHaOp.You found the handguns!"

translation: Znalazłeś pistolety!

source_text: Here… take the crossbow.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.Here… take the crossbow.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.Here… take the crossbow."

translation: Proszę… Weź kuszę.

source_text: If you want a timebomb, bring me a detonator.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.If you want a timebomb, bring me a detonator.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.If you want a timebomb, bring me a detonator."

translation: Jeśli chcesz bombę zegarową, przynieś mi detonator.

source_text: I have the detonator.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I have the detonator.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I have the detonator."

translation: Mam detonator.

source_text: Give it to me and I’ll make you a timebomb.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.Give it to me and I’ll make you a timebomb.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.Give it to me and I’ll make you a timebomb."

translation: Daj mi go, a zrobię ci bombę zegarową.

source_text: I’m in a hurry. How long will this take?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I’m in a hurry. How long will this take?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I’m in a hurry. How long will this take?"

translation: Spieszę się. Ile to zajmie?

source_text: This is dangerous stuff, 1Hero. I can’t rush it.

structure.raw_value: JoWoEx.This is dangerous stuff, 1Hero. I can’t rush it.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoEx.This is dangerous stuff, 1Hero. I can’t rush it."

translation: To niebezpieczna sprawa, 1Hero. Nie mogę się spieszyć.

source_text: I’ll come back later… But I need it today.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I’ll come back later… But I need it today.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I’ll come back later… But I need it today."

translation: Wrócę później… Ale potrzebuję tego jeszcze dzisiaj.

source_text: I’ll work fast.

structure.raw_value: JoFrEx.I’ll work fast.
structure.script_literal: "JoFrEx.I’ll work fast."

translation: Postaram się uwinąć.

source_text: I need a passport now!

structure.raw_value: H2MaEx.I need a passport now!
structure.script_literal: "H2MaEx.I need a passport now!"

translation: Potrzebuję paszportu. Natychmiast!

source_text: I said get the hell out of here.

structure.raw_value: JoMaExNo1>.I said get the hell out of here.
structure.script_literal: "JoMaExNo1>.I said get the hell out of here."

translation: Mówiłem, żebyś stąd, do cholery, spadał.

source_text: Careful, 1Hero! I don’t know what they put in there.

structure.raw_value: JoWoEx^.Careful, 1Hero! I don’t know what they put in there.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoEx^.Careful, 1Hero! I don’t know what they put in there."

translation: Uważaj, 1Hero! Nie wiem, co tam włożyli.

source_text: I’m sure the cops cleared it out.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I’m sure the cops cleared it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I’m sure the cops cleared it out."

translation: Na pewno gliniarze wszystko stamtąd zabrali.

source_text: You can’t hide! I’m coming after you, creep!

structure.raw_value: McMaOp.You can’t hide! I’m coming after you, creep!
structure.script_literal: "McMaOp.You can’t hide! I’m coming after you, creep!"

translation: Nie ukryjesz się! Dopadnę cię, zboczeńcu!

source_text: What’s here?

structure.raw_value: CaWoOp.What’s here?
structure.script_literal: "CaWoOp.What’s here?"

translation: Co to za miejsce?

source_text: Are we gonna buy some junk?

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp.Are we gonna buy some junk?
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp.Are we gonna buy some junk?"

translation: Będziemy kupować jakieś rupiecie?

source_text: I know Jon. You can lay low here.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.I know Jon. You can lay low here.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.I know Jon. You can lay low here."

translation: Znam Jona. Możecie się tu zaszyć.

source_text: We need a hideout.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx^.We need a hideout.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx^.We need a hideout."

translation: Potrzebujemy kryjówki.

source_text: If it’s not too much of a burden.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.If it’s not too much of a burden.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.If it’s not too much of a burden."

translation: Jeśli to nie będzie zbyt duży kłopot.

source_text: Haha. What kind of trouble are you all getting into?

structure.raw_value: JoFlDeNo3.Haha. What kind of trouble are you all getting into?
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDeNo3.Haha. What kind of trouble are you all getting into?"

translation: Haha. W jakie to kłopoty się wpakowaliście?

source_text: We’re running from a monster.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx^.We’re running from a monster.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx^.We’re running from a monster."

translation: Uciekamy przed potworem.

source_text: We’ve got some big problems at the mansion and I don’t trust that we’re safe.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We’ve got some big problems at the mansion and I don’t trust that we’re safe.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We’ve got some big problems at the mansion and I don’t trust that we’re safe."

translation: Mamy poważne problemy w rezydencji i nie czuję się tam bezpiecznie.

source_text: No need to explain. I’ve got you covered.

structure.raw_value: JoFlOp.No need to explain. I’ve got you covered.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlOp.No need to explain. I’ve got you covered."

translation: Nie musisz nic wyjaśniać. Zajmę się wami.

source_text: So what’s there to do around here?

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp^.So what’s there to do around here?
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp^.So what’s there to do around here?"

translation: No to co tu można robić?

source_text: We’re not here to have fun, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: ChAnEx^.We’re not here to have fun, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "ChAnEx^.We’re not here to have fun, Hannah."

translation: Nie przyjechaliśmy tu się bawić, Hannah.

source_text: There’s always fun to be had.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx^.There’s always fun to be had.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx^.There’s always fun to be had."

translation: Zawsze można znaleźć coś do zabawy.

source_text: I like the way the redhead thinks.

structure.raw_value: JoFlDe.I like the way the redhead thinks.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlDe.I like the way the redhead thinks."

translation: Podoba mi się, jak myśli ta ruda.

source_text: I’ve got to run. Take care of them.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I’ve got to run. Take care of them.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I’ve got to run. Take care of them."

translation: Muszę lecieć. Zaopiekuj się nimi.

source_text: I’ve got your back, 1Hero. Your harem is safe with me.

structure.raw_value: JoFlEx.I’ve got your back, 1Hero. Your harem is safe with me.
structure.script_literal: "JoFlEx.I’ve got your back, 1Hero. Your harem is safe with me."

translation: Możesz na mnie liczyć, 1Hero. Twój harem jest ze mną bezpieczny.

source_text: Harem?

structure.raw_value: HnWoCl^.Harem?
structure.script_literal: "HnWoCl^.Harem?"

translation: Harem?

source_text: This place has a lot of cool stuff! I want to buy something!

structure.raw_value: HnHaAg.This place has a lot of cool stuff! I want to buy something!
structure.script_literal: "HnHaAg.This place has a lot of cool stuff! I want to buy something!"

translation: Ale tu jest mnóstwo fajnych rzeczy! Chcę coś kupić!

source_text: Come back soon, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp.Come back soon, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp.Come back soon, 1Hero."

translation: Wróć wkrótce, 1Hero.

source_text: Stay safe, darling.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Stay safe, darling.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Stay safe, darling."

translation: Trzymaj się, kochanie.

source_text: Don’t get yourself into too much trouble, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: CaFlOp.Don’t get yourself into too much trouble, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlOp.Don’t get yourself into too much trouble, 1Hero."

translation: Nie pakuj się w zbyt wielkie kłopoty, 1Hero.

source_text: 1Hero, is everything okay?

structure.raw_value: HeWoOp.1Hero, is everything okay?
structure.script_literal: "HeWoOp.1Hero, is everything okay?"

translation: 1Hero, wszystko w porządku?

source_text: Everything’s okay… Father Solomon is at the mansion… keeping an eye on things.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Everything’s okay… Father Solomon is at the mansion… keeping an eye on things.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Everything’s okay… Father Solomon is at the mansion… keeping an eye on things."

translation: Wszystko w porządku… Ojciec Solomon jest w rezydencji… pilnuje sytuacji.

source_text: The priest is fighting monsters at the mansion?

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp^.The priest is fighting monsters at the mansion?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp^.The priest is fighting monsters at the mansion?"

translation: Ksiądz walczy z potworami w rezydencji?

source_text: Hopefully it doesn’t come to that.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Hopefully it doesn’t come to that.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Hopefully it doesn’t come to that."

translation: Oby nie musiało do tego dojść.

source_text: Any sign of the old lady?

structure.raw_value: CaBaDe.Any sign of the old lady?
structure.script_literal: "CaBaDe.Any sign of the old lady?"

translation: Widziałeś gdzieś tę staruszkę?

source_text: Madalyn is… not here anymore.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Madalyn is… not here anymore.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Madalyn is… not here anymore."

translation: Madalyn… już tu nie ma.

source_text: Thank God!

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp^.Thank God!
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp^.Thank God!"

translation: Dzięki Bogu!

source_text: I’m trying to stay out of your business, 1Hero, but something’s come up and I can’t look after your ladies anymore.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.I’m trying to stay out of your business, 1Hero, but something’s come up and I can’t look after your ladies anymore.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.I’m trying to stay out of your business, 1Hero, but something’s come up and I can’t look after your ladies anymore."

translation: Staram się nie wtrącać w twoje sprawy, 1Hero, ale coś wypadło i nie mogę już opiekować się twoimi dziewczynami.

source_text: A new client. Emergency shipping is needed apparently and I have to start working on the order now.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.A new client. Emergency shipping is needed apparently and I have to start working on the order now.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.A new client. Emergency shipping is needed apparently and I have to start working on the order now."

translation: Mam nowego klienta. Podobno potrzebuje pilnej dostawy, więc muszę już zająć się zamówieniem.

source_text: I was just starting to like it here.

structure.raw_value: HnSaDe^.I was just starting to like it here.
structure.script_literal: "HnSaDe^.I was just starting to like it here."

translation: Zaczynało mi się tu podobać.

source_text: We’ll get out of your hair, Jon.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We’ll get out of your hair, Jon.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We’ll get out of your hair, Jon."

translation: Nie będziemy ci już zawracać głowy, Jon.

source_text: We’ll go back to the church. There are people there.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We’ll go back to the church. There are people there.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We’ll go back to the church. There are people there."

translation: Wrócimy do kościoła. Są tam ludzie.

source_text: Is Sister Judy safe?

structure.raw_value: ChWoOp^.Is Sister Judy safe?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoOp^.Is Sister Judy safe?"

translation: Czy siostra Judy jest bezpieczna?

source_text: She’s not at the church. I brought her to the police station.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s not at the church. I brought her to the police station.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s not at the church. I brought her to the police station."

translation: Nie ma jej w kościele. Zabrałem ją na komisariat.

source_text: Now that sounds safe.

structure.raw_value: CaFrOp.Now that sounds safe.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrOp.Now that sounds safe."

translation: To brzmi bezpiecznie.

source_text: We could all go there if you’d rather… But we have to lay low.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We could all go there if you’d rather… But we have to lay low.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We could all go there if you’d rather… But we have to lay low."

translation: Możemy tam wszyscy pójść, jeśli wolisz… Ale musimy się nie rzucać w oczy.

source_text: I want to go back to the church and play in the woods.

structure.raw_value: HnSaEx^.I want to go back to the church and play in the woods.
structure.script_literal: "HnSaEx^.I want to go back to the church and play in the woods."

translation: Chcę wrócić do kościoła i pobawić się w lesie.

source_text: You’ll be sticking close to me, young lady.

structure.raw_value: CaAnDe.You’ll be sticking close to me, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnDe.You’ll be sticking close to me, young lady."

translation: Będziesz trzymać się blisko mnie, młoda damo.

source_text: The church is safe. If anything comes out of the rift, I’ll let you know.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.The church is safe. If anything comes out of the rift, I’ll let you know.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.The church is safe. If anything comes out of the rift, I’ll let you know."

translation: Kościół jest bezpieczny. Jeśli coś wyjdzie ze szczeliny, dam ci znać.

source_text: A rift?

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.A rift?
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.A rift?"

translation: Ze szczeliny?

source_text: It’s hard to explain… Everyone just stay away from the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It’s hard to explain… Everyone just stay away from the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It’s hard to explain… Everyone just stay away from the mansion."

translation: Trudno to wyjaśnić… Po prostu wszyscy trzymajcie się z dala od rezydencji.

source_text: I suspected a cult was forming there.

structure.raw_value: JoBaDe.I suspected a cult was forming there.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaDe.I suspected a cult was forming there."

translation: Podejrzewałem, że powstaje tam sekta.

source_text: You don’t have to tell me twice. The Lord protects us, but we also have to use our brains.

structure.raw_value: CaWoEx.You don’t have to tell me twice. The Lord protects us, but we also have to use our brains.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoEx.You don’t have to tell me twice. The Lord protects us, but we also have to use our brains."

translation: Nie musisz mi dwa razy powtarzać. Pan nas chroni, ale sami też musimy używać rozumu.

source_text: Amen! Now let's go back so I can find my pet alligator.

structure.raw_value: HnHaEx^.Amen! Now let's go back so I can find my pet alligator.
structure.script_literal: "HnHaEx^.Amen! Now let's go back so I can find my pet alligator."

translation: Amen! Wracajmy już, żebym mogła znaleźć swojego aligatora.

source_text: Hannah Ray!

structure.raw_value: CaMaAgNo1.Hannah Ray!
structure.script_literal: "CaMaAgNo1.Hannah Ray!"

translation: Hannah Ray!

source_text: 1Hero, perhaps you can help me out.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.1Hero, perhaps you can help me out.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.1Hero, perhaps you can help me out."

translation: 1Hero, może mógłbyś mi pomóc.

source_text: My client needs some high-tech security locks and I need them today.

structure.raw_value: JoWoEx.My client needs some high-tech security locks and I need them today.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoEx.My client needs some high-tech security locks and I need them today."

translation: Mój klient potrzebuje zaawansowanych zamków elektronicznych i muszę je zdobyć jeszcze dzisiaj.

source_text: You don’t have any?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.You don’t have any?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.You don’t have any?"

translation: Nie masz żadnych?

source_text: The kind I need takes weeks to order. But perhaps you can do me this favor.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.The kind I need takes weeks to order. But perhaps you can do me this favor.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.The kind I need takes weeks to order. But perhaps you can do me this favor."

translation: Na takie, jakich potrzebuję, czeka się tygodniami. Może mógłbyś wyświadczyć mi przysługę.

source_text: How do I get a hold of them?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.How do I get a hold of them?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.How do I get a hold of them?"

translation: Skąd je wziąć?

source_text: The police station. It’s the same system you use there for your door locks.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.The police station. It’s the same system you use there for your door locks.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.The police station. It’s the same system you use there for your door locks."

translation: Z komisariatu. To ten sam system, którego używacie w zamkach do drzwi.

source_text: Are you sure? I don’t remember seeing any.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Are you sure? I don’t remember seeing any.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Are you sure? I don’t remember seeing any."

translation: Na pewno? Nie przypominam sobie, żebym jakieś widział.

source_text: Not every door has it. But I know for a fact that it’s policy to keep extras on-hand.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.Not every door has it. But I know for a fact that it’s policy to keep extras on-hand.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.Not every door has it. But I know for a fact that it’s policy to keep extras on-hand."

translation: Nie każde drzwi je mają. Ale wiem na pewno, że przepisy nakazują trzymać zapasowe na miejscu.

source_text: I have no idea where they would be.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I have no idea where they would be.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I have no idea where they would be."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, gdzie mogą być.

source_text: You’re my only hope, 1Hero. They are called fingerprint locks.

structure.raw_value: JoBaEx.You’re my only hope, 1Hero. They are called fingerprint locks.
structure.script_literal: "JoBaEx.You’re my only hope, 1Hero. They are called fingerprint locks."

translation: Tylko ty możesz mi pomóc, 1Hero. Chodzi o zamki na odcisk palca.

source_text: Well… You did watch the ladies for me…

structure.raw_value: McFrDe.Well… You did watch the ladies for me…
structure.script_literal: "McFrDe.Well… You did watch the ladies for me…"

translation: Cóż… W końcu pilnowałeś dla mnie tych dziewczyn…

source_text: Get them to me soon, 1Hero. I have a lot of prep work to get done before tonight.

structure.raw_value: JoWoEx.Get them to me soon, 1Hero. I have a lot of prep work to get done before tonight.
structure.script_literal: "JoWoEx.Get them to me soon, 1Hero. I have a lot of prep work to get done before tonight."

translation: Jak najszybciej mi je przynieś, 1Hero. Mam mnóstwo przygotowań przed dzisiejszym wieczorem.

source_text: I’m telling you, I can’t find him.

structure.raw_value: NeAnEx.I’m telling you, I can’t find him.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnEx.I’m telling you, I can’t find him."

translation: Mówię ci, nie mogę go znaleźć.

source_text: Ella?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Ella?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Ella?"

translation: Ello?

source_text: I’m getting paid, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx^.I’m getting paid, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx^.I’m getting paid, 1Hero."

translation: Dostanę za to zapłatę, 1Hero.

source_text: Fuck Duncan. I want that treasure.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Fuck Duncan. I want that treasure.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Fuck Duncan. I want that treasure."

translation: Jebać Duncana. Chcę ten skarb.

source_text: What treasure? You didn’t pack everything?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.What treasure? You didn’t pack everything?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.What treasure? You didn’t pack everything?"

translation: Jaki skarb? Nie spakowałaś wszystkiego?

source_text: She wants the Toma.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.She wants the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.She wants the Toma."

translation: Ona chce Tomę.

source_text: You want it gone, don’t you?

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.You want it gone, don’t you?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.You want it gone, don’t you?"

translation: Chcesz się tego pozbyć, prawda?

source_text: It needs to be destroyed.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.It needs to be destroyed.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.It needs to be destroyed."

translation: Trzeba to zniszczyć.

source_text: But the pieces will still work, right?

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx^.But the pieces will still work, right?
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx^.But the pieces will still work, right?"

translation: Ale nawet w kawałkach nadal będzie działać, prawda?

source_text: Ella… Erica is gone…

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.Ella… Erica is gone…
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.Ella… Erica is gone…"

translation: Ella… Eriki już nie ma…

source_text: She looked at the Toma.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.She looked at the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.She looked at the Toma."

translation: Spojrzała na Tomę.

source_text: No! How!?

structure.raw_value: ElShClNo1^.No! How!?
structure.script_literal: "ElShClNo1^.No! How!?"

translation: Nie! Jak to!?

source_text: It’s hard to explain… Lilith took her body.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.It’s hard to explain… Lilith took her body.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.It’s hard to explain… Lilith took her body."

translation: Trudno to wyjaśnić… Lilith przejęła jej ciało.

source_text: There has to be a way to fix this! There’s always a way!

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx^.There has to be a way to fix this! There’s always a way!
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx^.There has to be a way to fix this! There’s always a way!"

translation: Musi być jakiś sposób, żeby to naprawić! Zawsze jest jakiś sposób!

source_text: Brian… He can kill the demons.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.Brian… He can kill the demons.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.Brian… He can kill the demons."

translation: Brian… On potrafi zabijać demony.

source_text: He can… But they are not easy to keep track of… They can teleport.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.He can… But they are not easy to keep track of… They can teleport.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.He can… But they are not easy to keep track of… They can teleport."

translation: Potrafi… Ale trudno je wytropić… Umieją się teleportować.

source_text: If you kill Lilith… what chance do we have of getting back Erica?

structure.raw_value: ElWoDe^.If you kill Lilith… what chance do we have of getting back Erica?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoDe^.If you kill Lilith… what chance do we have of getting back Erica?"

translation: Jeśli zabijesz Lilith… jakie będziemy mieli szanse odzyskać Ericę?

source_text: … She claims she can save Erica.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.… She claims she can save Erica.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.… She claims she can save Erica."

translation: … Twierdzi, że może uratować Ericę.

source_text: Then stop whining and go find her!

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Then stop whining and go find her!
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Then stop whining and go find her!"

translation: To przestań marudzić i ją znajdź!

source_text: 1Hero… I get eight million more if I can find it.

structure.raw_value: ElShEx^.1Hero… I get eight million more if I can find it.
structure.script_literal: "ElShEx^.1Hero… I get eight million more if I can find it."

translation: 1Hero… Dostanę jeszcze osiem milionów, jeśli to znajdę.

source_text: This is dangerous.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.This is dangerous.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.This is dangerous."

translation: To niebezpieczne.

source_text: We have to find it anyway.

structure.raw_value: ElWoEx^.We have to find it anyway.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoEx^.We have to find it anyway."

translation: I tak musimy to znaleźć.

source_text: Let’s say we find it. Can we destroy it?

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.Let’s say we find it. Can we destroy it?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.Let’s say we find it. Can we destroy it?"

translation: Załóżmy, że to znajdziemy. Czy możemy to zniszczyć?

source_text: Those effects… they will work even if it’s in pieces.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Those effects… they will work even if it’s in pieces.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Those effects… they will work even if it’s in pieces."

translation: Te efekty… będą działać nawet wtedy, gdy rozbijemy to na kawałki.

source_text: I tried to break it… It didn’t work.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I tried to break it… It didn’t work.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I tried to break it… It didn’t work."

translation: Próbowałem to rozbić… Bez skutku.

source_text: Well… We can try harder next time.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx^.Well… We can try harder next time.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx^.Well… We can try harder next time."

translation: Cóż… Następnym razem możemy spróbować mocniej.

source_text: Diana? Henry?

structure.raw_value: McShOpNo1.Diana? Henry?
structure.script_literal: "McShOpNo1.Diana? Henry?"

translation: Diana? Henry?

source_text: We had to sneak out.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.We had to sneak out.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.We had to sneak out."

translation: Musieliśmy wymknąć się po cichu.

source_text: Cops were everywhere.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx^.Cops were everywhere.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx^.Cops were everywhere."

translation: Wszędzie byli gliniarze.

source_text: Did you see Lillian?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Did you see Lillian?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Did you see Lillian?"

translation: Widzieliście Lillian?

source_text: We couldn’t find anyone… Madalyn has more monsters for her army.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.We couldn’t find anyone… Madalyn has more monsters for her army.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.We couldn’t find anyone… Madalyn has more monsters for her army."

translation: Nikogo nie znaleźliśmy… Madalyn ma więcej potworów do swojej armii.

source_text: Where’s Duncan? Did they arrest him?

structure.raw_value: DiWoOp^.Where’s Duncan? Did they arrest him?
structure.script_literal: "DiWoOp^.Where’s Duncan? Did they arrest him?"

translation: Gdzie jest Duncan? Aresztowali go?

source_text: Lilith saved him… I don’t know where they are.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Lilith saved him… I don’t know where they are.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Lilith saved him… I don’t know where they are."

translation: Lilith go uratowała… Nie wiem, gdzie są.

source_text: 1Hero… There’s something you need to know.

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.1Hero… There’s something you need to know.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoEx.1Hero… There’s something you need to know."

translation: 1Hero… Musisz coś wiedzieć.

source_text: Madalyn stole something called a soul crystal.

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.Madalyn stole something called a soul crystal.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoEx.Madalyn stole something called a soul crystal."

translation: Madalyn ukradła coś, co nazywa się kryształem duszy.

source_text: She’s using it to store the soul of a powerful demon.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx^.She’s using it to store the soul of a powerful demon.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx^.She’s using it to store the soul of a powerful demon."

translation: Używa go, by przechować duszę potężnego demona.

source_text: I don’t know why. Madalyn had the soul inside of her… but she gave it up.

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.I don’t know why. Madalyn had the soul inside of her… but she gave it up.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoEx.I don’t know why. Madalyn had the soul inside of her… but she gave it up."

translation: Nie wiem dlaczego. Madalyn miała tę duszę w sobie… ale się jej pozbyła.

source_text: To allow Lilith to come to Earth.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.To allow Lilith to come to Earth.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.To allow Lilith to come to Earth."

translation: Żeby umożliwić Lilith przybycie na Ziemię.

source_text: But why? She already had the soul of a demon. Why Lilith?

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.But why? She already had the soul of a demon. Why Lilith?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.But why? She already had the soul of a demon. Why Lilith?"

translation: Ale dlaczego? Miała już w sobie duszę demona. Czemu Lilith?

source_text: Because they share the same end goal.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Because they share the same end goal.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Because they share the same end goal."

translation: Bo mają ten sam cel.

source_text: Madalyn came here specifically for Zephaniah… Together they opened the rift.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Madalyn came here specifically for Zephaniah… Together they opened the rift.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Madalyn came here specifically for Zephaniah… Together they opened the rift."

translation: Madalyn przybyła tu specjalnie po Zephaniaha… Razem otworzyli szczelinę.

source_text: Perhaps she needed Daemalius’ power to open it.

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.Perhaps she needed Daemalius’ power to open it.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.Perhaps she needed Daemalius’ power to open it."

translation: Może potrzebowała mocy Daemaliusa, żeby ją otworzyć.

source_text: And after they opened it… She used the crystal to keep his soul locked away.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx.And after they opened it… She used the crystal to keep his soul locked away.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx.And after they opened it… She used the crystal to keep his soul locked away."

translation: A kiedy ją otworzyli… Użyła kryształu, by uwięzić w nim jego duszę.

source_text: What is this soul crystal you speak of? Where did it come from?

structure.raw_value: AdBaDe.What is this soul crystal you speak of? Where did it come from?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaDe.What is this soul crystal you speak of? Where did it come from?"

translation: Czym jest ten kryształ duszy, o którym mówisz? Skąd się wziął?

source_text: How much will you give me if I find that?

structure.raw_value: ElFlOp^.How much will you give me if I find that?
structure.script_literal: "ElFlOp^.How much will you give me if I find that?"

translation: Ile mi zapłacisz, jeśli go znajdę?

source_text: The cops are coming!

structure.raw_value: JoWoEx^.The cops are coming!
structure.script_literal: "JoWoEx^.The cops are coming!"

translation: Gliniarze jadą!

source_text: Hey! What are they doing here?

structure.raw_value: JoAnOp^.Hey! What are they doing here?
structure.script_literal: "JoAnOp^.Hey! What are they doing here?"

translation: Hej! Co oni tu robią?

source_text: We need to get out of here.

structure.raw_value: NeWoEx.We need to get out of here.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoEx.We need to get out of here."

translation: Musimy się stąd wydostać.

source_text: We can go back… But the cops are at the mansion too.

structure.raw_value: HrWoEx.We can go back… But the cops are at the mansion too.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoEx.We can go back… But the cops are at the mansion too."

translation: Możemy wrócić… Ale gliniarze są też w rezydencji.

source_text: I’m not going to jail. I’ll die before I do.

structure.raw_value: ElAnOp^.I’m not going to jail. I’ll die before I do.
structure.script_literal: "ElAnOp^.I’m not going to jail. I’ll die before I do."

translation: Nie pójdę do więzienia. Prędzej zginę.

source_text: There’s a way out… We can go to the church.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s a way out… We can go to the church.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s a way out… We can go to the church."

translation: Jest wyjście… Możemy iść do kościoła.

source_text: Close the bunker, Jon. Don’t let those cops touch any of my treasure.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Close the bunker, Jon. Don’t let those cops touch any of my treasure.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Close the bunker, Jon. Don’t let those cops touch any of my treasure."

translation: Zamknij bunkier, Jon. Nie pozwól tym gliniarzom tknąć moich skarbów.

source_text: Go! Quickly!

structure.raw_value: JoAnEx^.Go! Quickly!
structure.script_literal: "JoAnEx^.Go! Quickly!"

translation: Uciekajcie! Szybko!

source_text: I can’t wait for our next adventure!

structure.raw_value: ErHaOp.I can’t wait for our next adventure!
structure.script_literal: "ErHaOp.I can’t wait for our next adventure!"

translation: Nie mogę się doczekać naszej następnej przygody!
